claim: Nikon CFI Apo Lambda S 40XC WI, part number MRD77400: a water-immersion 40x objective of numerical aperture 1.25 with a correction collar, specified for coverglass from 150 to 190 micrometres. Its working distance is quoted as a range, 0.16 to 0.2 mm, because it depends on where the correction collar is set.

numbers.name: working_distance_min
numbers.note: the quoted range is carried as its two ends; compressing a range into one value would stop it being a quotation

validity_conditions: Catalog specification for this part number, capped at E3 because a published specification is not a measurement taken here. The working distance is collar-dependent, and the collar setting is determined once the coverglass thickness is fixed -- so at the 170 micrometres this laboratory uses (coverslip_thickness_in_use) the working distance is a single value rather than a range. The catalog does not publish that value, and the librarian does not interpolate within a quoted range, so it is recorded as a condition_mismatch gap rather than derived. This is the one lens on this nosepiece with a real correction collar.
